pre_publish_rehearsal.note: Dispatched against the exact commit later tagged. The rehearsal packs and verifies its own tarballs; the tag-push run packs and publishes its own bytes independently. npm publish, post-publish smoke and GitHub Release creation are disabled for workflow_dispatch.

security.note: Exact overrides freeze a resolved version, so a pin that is clean when chosen can later become vulnerable in place. These are re-audited at each release rather than assumed to hold.

scorecard.note: Last measured during M H14. Not re-run against this release.

accepted_limitations: rollback leaves empty directories the AI created (documented limitation #6)
shell --pty interception is best-effort and experimental, not a sandbox
external effects (deployments, databases, API calls) are out of rollback scope
sessions ended before 0.8.0 have no recorded contribution and cannot use selective recovery
selective recovery refuses drift rather than reconciling it, and --force does not override that
--finding accepts full fnd_<64 hex> ids only; short prefixes are refused
contribution_sha256 is not comparable across operating systems by design (the executable bit is a real boolean on POSIX and unreportable on Windows)

publication.dist_tag_note: beta is moved by the publish workflow; latest is moved manually after publication, per release policy. Both verified across all 10 publish targets.

post_publish_verification.npm_provenance: 10/10 publish targets carry provenance attestations (registry dist.attestations)
post_publish_verification.published_tarball_sha256_vs_tag_run_rc_b: 10/10 byte-identical (each published tarball fetched from the registry and verified against the checksums.txt attached to the GitHub Release)
post_publish_verification.functional_smoke: published viberevert installs from the registry and reports 0.8.0-beta.1; all 9 internal @viberevert/* dependencies resolve at 0.8.0-beta.1
post_publish_verification.unqualified_install: npm install viberevert with no tag resolves to 0.8.0-beta.1
post_publish_verification.oidc_token_lockdown: in force since 2026-08-15: Trusted Publisher = GitHub Actions / release.yml on madeinplutofabio/vibe-revert; no legacy automation or publish tokens; the repository carries zero Actions secrets and release.yml references no token
